title: Great Introduction to Barcelona
text: As a first-time visitor to Barcelona, this tour was a great introduction to both the tapas culture and history of the country. Our guide Berta was engaging and enthusuastic about sharing information. I've been on tours before where the guides seemed to be phoning it in without asking questions of the participants or acting interested at all, but this was definitely not the case here. The pacing was great, and both the food and beverage choices were delicious.
